tutorials.text:
# Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia Archipelago Randomizer Setup Guide

## Required Software

- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases).


- BizHawk version 2.10 or newer    
- A legally obtained US ROM of Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia. The MD5 hash should be e13bdcf706989486df939556eeb42ece.

## Installation Procedures

### Windows Setup

1. Download and install Archipelago from the link above, making sure to install the most recent version.

## Create a Config (.yaml) File

### What is a config file and why do I need one?

See the guide on setting up a basic YAML at the Archipelago setup
guide: [Basic Multiworld Setup Guide](/tutorial/Archipelago/setup/en)

### Where do I get an options file?

The Player Options page on the website allows you to configure your personal options and export a config file from
them. You can also create one with your local Archipelago install.

### Verifying your config file

If you would like to validate your config file to make sure it works, you may do so on the YAML Validator page. YAML
validator page: [YAML Validation page](/mysterycheck)

## Joining a MultiWorld Game

### Generating and Patching a Game
1. Follow the general Archipelago instructions for generating a game. This will generate an output file for you. Your patch file will have the .apcvpor file extension.
   Open ArchipelagoLauncher.exe
2. Select "Open Patch" on the left side and select your patch file. Alternatively, you can open the ArchipelagoBizhawkClient with your patch file.
3. If this is your first time patching, you will be prompted to locate your vanilla ROM.
4. A patched .nds file will be created in the same place as the patch file.
5. On your first time opening a patch with BizHawk Client, you will also be asked to locate EmuHawk.exe in your BizHawk install.

If you are playing offline, you can simply run your ROM at this point. For Multiworld play, see the following section.

### Connecting to a Server
By default, opening a patch file will do steps 1-5 below for you automatically. Even so, keep them in your memory just in case you have to close and reopen a window mid-game for some reason.

1. This game uses Archipelago's BizHawk Client. If the client isn't still open from when you patched your game, you can re-open it from the launcher.
2. Ensure EmuHawk is running the patched ROM.
3. In EmuHawk, go to Tools > Lua Console. This window must stay open while playing.
4. In the Lua Console window, go to Script > Open Script….
5. Navigate to your Archipelago install folder and open data/lua/connector_bizhawk_generic.lua.
6. The emulator may freeze every few seconds until it manages to connect to the client. This is expected. The BizHawk Client window should indicate that it connected and recognized the game.
7. To connect the client to the server, enter your room's address and port (e.g. archipelago.gg:38281) into the top text field of the client and click Connect.
8. You should now be able to receive and send items. You'll need to do these steps every time you want to reconnect. It is perfectly safe to make progress offline; everything will re-sync when you reconnect.

notes.text:
# Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia Archipelago Version 2.1 #
## New Settings ##
* ``Shuffle Cerberus Glyphs``: Dictates where the Cerberus Glyphs get placed. 
  * ``Vanilla``: Forces the Cerberus glyphs to be in their normal locations
  * ``Regional``: Forces the Cerberus glyphs to be anywhere in their original regions (Library, Arms Depot, and Mechanical Tower)
   * ``Shuffled``: Forces the Cerberus Glyphs to be anywhere in Dracula's Castle
   * ``Shuffled Singular``: The same as Shuffled, but guarantees there will only be one Cerberus glyph in that area
   * `` Anywhere``: Places the Cerberus Glyphs into the general item pool (current behavior)
* ``Dracula Villagers Required``: How many Villagers need to be saved in order to fight Dracula.
* Added new Logic Tricks
  * ``Misty Forest Ledges with Kicks``: Trick for getting the ledge items in Misty Forest Road with only Double Jump
  * ``Speed Boots in Logic``: Adds logic for certain jumps while having either the Mercury or Winged boots equipped.
* ``Family Quests without Everyone``: Allows you to do Serge, Anna, and Irina's quests as soon as they're found without needing all 3 of them.
* ``Shop Randomizer``: Randomizes items in the shop.
* ``Unlock Full Shop``: Unlocks the quest reward shop items by default.
* ``Dominusless Barlowe``: If enabled, you'll be able to activate Barlowe without needing to collect the pieces of Dominus first.
## Changes ##
* The right entrance to Wallman's room now has a boss door
* The Cube Glyph in Monastery no longer respawns after being absorbed once
* Filler and Progression AP Glyphs will now be colored cyan and purple respectively
* If Glyphs are set to shuffled, Demon Lord now has a second copy of Barlowe's Glyph rather than a unique Glyph
* If Glyphs are set to shuffled, Demon Lord and Jiang Shi are removed from the enemy glyph pool if Large Cavern is disabled
* ``Tymeo Mountains Spike Room With Arma Felix`` trick has been changed to ``Cross Spikes with Arma Felix`` and now covers the Lighthouse and generator puzzle room as well.
## Fixes ##
* Fixed some options having minor errors in their description
* Fixed Wedding Dress always appearing as a quest-important item
* Fixed Abram's 4th quest checking the wrong completion flag
* Fixed the event where Jacob gives you the VIP Card breaking the game
* Fixed the Camera being logically required even if you have Photo 2
* The Minera Prison Island exit chest no longer disappears on hard mode
## Known Issues ##
* None so Far
